purpose: Present the owner's Tesla-account vehicle orders, lifecycle distribution and delivery outlook.
primaryGoal: Review order progress, assigned VINs and upcoming deliveries, refresh the account snapshot, and search, sort, filter and export order details without losing source context.

dataSources.behavior: Account snapshot, not vehicle- or range-scoped. request receives AbortSignal; staleTime is STALE_TIMES.SLOW (five minutes). orders defaults to [] for presentation; fetched_at remains nullable. No additional polling is configured by this hook.
dataSources.contract: TeslaOrdersEnvelope { orders: TeslaOrder[], fetched_at: string|null }. TeslaOrder retains id, order_id, model, status, delivery_date, vin, optional referral_code, is_upgradable, fetched_at, created_at and updated_at.
dataSources.endpointVerification: Frontend path and backend nested route match by source inspection. Handler, persistence queries, Tesla upstream behavior and HTTP responses were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.behavior: Success invalidates the existing orders query and emits a localized success toast; failure uses the existing mutation error toast. The router applies a five-per-minute IP limit. Header refresh is disabled and aria-busy while pending; empty-panel refresh lacks equivalent pending wiring.
dataSources.endpointVerification: Source route matches; no mutation executed.

dataSources.owner: Local order derivations plus existing date and operational-metric presentation owners
dataSources.behavior: One aggregate pass classifies raw statuses, counts models/VINs/upgradable orders and finds the minimum valid future delivery timestamp using Date.now(). Operational summary uses six metrics and nullable raw input. Date presentation uses saved locale and timezone; snapshot period explicitly says it is not a date-range total. No physical-unit measurements or conversion are introduced.
dataSources.evidenceLimit: Formatting owner internals, settings endpoints and actual server field nullability were not fully traced. Preserve raw payloads, query keys and existing classification; no backend capability is inferred.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.contract: Existing full-width min-w-0 adapter; shell owns navigation and workspace controls. Page supplies query and dataSources, not a whole-page loading/error gate.

components.name: LayoutCard
components.contract: Persistent title/actions/children/footer with existing Card, heading IDs and responsive container; keep board and detail shells.

components.name: OrdersOperationalBrief
components.contract: Six metrics, snapshot scope/provenance, sourceStatus and loading; preserve useOperationalMetrics rather than rebuilding a KPI grid.

components.name: OrderStatusBreakdown
components.contract: Five lifecycle buckets, proportion bar, exact counts and percentages; shared GlassPanel/PanelTitle/Badge/Text.

components.name: DeliveryOutlookPanel
components.contract: Upcoming delivery, upgradable/model counts, VIN assigned/total and last synced; existing KVList, TimeStamp and useDateFormat.

components.name: OrdersBoard / OrderCard
components.contract: Accessible named list with memoized GlassPanel order groups; model, raw-status presentation, ID, VIN, delivery and upgrade availability.

components.name: OrdersTable / DataTable
components.kind: domain adapter and sole shared table pipeline
components.contract: Stable tableId admin:tesla-orders; six columns; text/value filters; model/status/delivery sorts; pagination and inherited CSV/JSON export/column persistence. Shared implementation owner is web\src\components\ui\DataTable.tsx.

components.name: OrdersSectionState
components.contract: loading/error/empty/ready; shared Skeleton, QueryError and EmptyState. Existing SourceContent is the overlapping canonical owner, not a reason to remove section-specific geometry/copy.

components.name: DataSourceNotice
components.contract: PageContainer renders it before retained children; resolves failure/refresh failure/paused states and existing recovery semantics.

components.name: Button / EmptyState / FadeIn / SectionErrorBoundary
components.contract: Category imports already used. FadeIn owner web\src\components\motion\FadeIn.tsx:23 uses motion preference and initial=false when reduced. Boundary and Button internals not independently audited.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: A local four-state branch duplicates the existing SourceContent loading/error/empty renderer. It correctly keeps four panel shells present, so consolidation must not replace them with one page gate.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Adapt through existing SourceContent only after mapping fatalError versus retained, specialist skeleton heights, localized query-error recovery and board/table empty actions.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Summary and outlook intentionally repeat next delivery/upgradable counts; board and table intentionally offer visual and detailed views. This is complementary context, not redundant data that may be deleted.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep all views; continue sharing computeOrderStats and the existing operational metric bridge.

sourceBehavior.detail: Insights stack until xl; status breakdown takes two of three columns at xl. Header actions wrap and wrapLabel is set.
Bucket cards reflow through two, three and five columns.
Table wrapper has min-w-0; search width is constrained without constraining the entire page.

issues.detail: auto-fit minmax(18rem,1fr) imposes a 288px minimum inside a padded LayoutCard and shell gutters. A 320px viewport can allocate less than this; overflow is a source-backed risk, not observed clipping.
issues.fix: Use the existing grid policy or a container-safe minimum bounded by 100%, retaining every card and all fields.

issues.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043 / no mobile information loss
issues.detail: mobileColumns only exposes model/status. DataTable.tsx:724-725 hides other cells below md; this caller supplies neither mobilePresentation nor expandable detail. VIN/ID/date are partly available on the separate board, but filtered table rows lose the complete row context at narrow widths.
issues.fix: Adopt the existing typed DataTable mobilePresentation/details contract with all six fields, retaining filters, sorting, pagination, column preferences and export scope. Do not invent a second table renderer.

sourceStrengths.detail: Summary/insights sections have localized accessible names; decorative page icons are aria-hidden.
Cards expose model/status group names and semantic dl/dt/dd fields; board uses ul/li.
Search Input has localized aria-label; shared table supplies caption/native semantics.
Reduced entrance sets initial=false; no local replacement motion engine is needed.

issues.detail: Model is visually truncated without a local full-text disclosure. ID/VIN use title attributes, which do not establish touch or keyboard disclosure. Other table presentation may provide the full value; actual reachability remains unverified.
issues.fix: Retain full source identifiers/model in a wrapping or existing keyboard/touch-accessible detail presentation, without relying on hover titles alone.

accessibility.limits: No mounted keyboard/focus/screen-reader, effective contrast, forced-colors, RTL, 200%-text or 44px target tests were run. The proportion bar has a generic image label and adjacent textual counts; assess their association during runtime QA.

states.initialLoading: deriveDataState initial maps to loading for each data panel; summary receives loading and null stats. Panel geometry uses heights 180/200/320. PageContainer receives query but no loading prop, preserving all section shells.
states.fatalError: Only ordersState.fatalError maps to error; four sections offer QueryError/refetch. Summary remains with unavailable metrics and source status. SectionErrorBoundary isolates breakdown group, board and table.
states.empty: Board/table distinguish unsynced versus successfully synced-empty via fetched_at and offer account refresh; breakdown/outlook show their own messages. Empty successful arrays have true zero counts in the summary, not invented measurements.
states.ready: All sections render from the same retained order snapshot and shared aggregate.
states.refreshError: Retained data remains visible. PageContainer.tsx:253 supplies DataSourceNotice and the operational brief receives stale status; local section status remains ready/empty rather than erasing data.
states.offline: deriveDataState documents retained paused requests as stale/isRefreshBlocked; shared DataSourceNotice handles initial paused requests. A retained paused source is not specifically labelled by its resolver unless another error triggers a notice; summary still exposes retained status. Runtime offline recovery is unverified.
states.partialUnknown: Page does not supply partial/unavailable options or maxAgeMs to deriveDataState. Missing envelope orders defaults to [] but summary only accepts Array.isArray orders; backend malformed/partial response handling remains unknown. No local max-age threshold should be invented.
states.mutation: Header pending guard and toast success/failure exist; repeated empty actions lack pending UI.

issues.detail: Both empty-panel Refresh actions call mutate without pending/disabled wiring, while the header is disabled at line 91. EmptyState.tsx:13 and :84 only accept label/onClick, so users can request duplicate rate-limited refreshes from two panels.
issues.fix: Guard the existing mutate callback while pending and use the existing Button state model for visibly disabled/busy recovery. If extending EmptyState action props, the shared feedback owner must own the change; do not fork the empty-state renderer.

visualIssues.detail: Bucket surfaces use border-white/bg-white and the bar track uses bg-white at line 62, instead of theme-aware neutral surface/border tokens. No neon/glow was found in the mounted files, but fixed-white decoration is still inconsistent across themes.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing neutral surface/control/border variables; keep lifecycle colors and text/count alternatives semantic. Dynamic percentage width is legitimate data-driven styling.

visualIssues.detail: Upcoming date gets a permanent cyan tinted bordered tile; neutral informational panel icons are also cyan here and in TeslaOrdersPage.tsx:149,170. Upgrade availability has a separate purple tile in OrderCard.tsx:106. Multiple accent treatments compete with lifecycle status color.
visualIssues.fix: Subdue informational icon/date chrome using existing muted/neutral tokens while retaining a meaningful upgrade cue and all lifecycle distinctions; no new palette, glow, wrapper or preference reset.

architectureIssues.detail: Computed column keys delivery/upgradable differ from raw fields delivery_date/is_upgradable and do not provide exportValue. DataTable.tsx:884-893 falls back to rendered text when the keyed raw field is undefined, so JSON may contain formatted date and Yes/em-dash strings rather than canonical source values.
architectureIssues.fix: Provide typed exportValue or exportRow through the existing table API after pinning current CSV/JSON expectations; preserve localized readable CSV and explicit boolean/null/date meaning. Do not silently change existing exports during cosmetic adoption.

priority.rationale: Mobile complete-detail access and container overflow should precede restrained presentation cleanup; mutation recovery and export semantics need preservation-aware integration.
order: Pin existing sections/actions/query and export semantics
Resolve narrow board and complete mobile table details

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse DataTable mobilePresentation; no competing mobile table
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Existing mobilePresentation plus stable tableId, all six fields, full row details, current filters/sorts/pagination and loaded-result CSV/JSON controls. Keep standalone/embedded policy owned by DataTable.
dependsOn: Shared table owner acceptance of current mobile detail contract
Page-specific typed source adapter and runtime narrow-width parity
requiredSharedChanges.note: No shared source edit is established as necessary; caller adoption first.

requiredSharedChanges.name: EmptyState async recovery action parity
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Optional disabled/loading/aria-busy forwarding for imperative primary and secondary actions using existing Button behavior; retain label/onClick and navigation-action precedence.
dependsOn: Foundation owner confirmation from a second independent production consumer before general API extension
requiredSharedChanges.note: Two occurrences on this page do not establish two independent production consumers. This is a concrete gap, not authorization for a speculative shared API or a second recovery renderer.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Reuse SourceContent trust states
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: loadingContent, emptyContent/emptyRecovery, fatal errorRecovery and retained state while keeping four independent panel shells and localized specialist copy.
dependsOn: Keep existing DataSourceNotice and OperationalBrief source context
requiredSharedChanges.note: Existing owner covers the general state pattern. Do not introduce another universal state engine.

competingImplementations.detail: Local state renderer overlaps SourceContent; reuse mapping is proposed, not a new shared primitive.
competingImplementations.fix: Retain domain copy and geometry through existing owner overrides.

competingImplementations.detail: Barrel still exports TeslaOrdersKpiBand, but mounted page uses OrdersOperationalBrief. Its implementation/callers were not fully inspected; unused status is not proved.
competingImplementations.fix: Do not restore the former KPI band or delete it on this audit's evidence. Canonical mounted owner is OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics.

competingImplementations.detail: Page has no competing vehicle/range picker. Account snapshot is explicitly not a range total.
competingImplementations.fix: Keep shell selection ownership; do not add date/vehicle controls or imply server filtering absent from these hooks.

preservation.lineCountScope: Page plus OrdersOperationalBrief, OrderStatusBreakdown, DeliveryOutlookPanel, OrdersBoard, OrderCard, OrdersTable and OrdersSectionState; excludes pure stats utility, barrel, unmounted old KPI component and tests.

sections.name: Order summary
sections.content: Total, delivered, in progress, ready/transit, upgradable, next delivery; snapshot scope/provenance and source status.

sections.name: Order status
sections.content: inProgress, ready, delivered, cancelled, other; ordered proportion bar plus exact counts/percentages.

sections.name: Delivery outlook
sections.content: Upcoming delivery, upgradable orders, distinct models, assigned VIN/total, last synced.

sections.name: Orders board
sections.content: Every order card with model/status/ID/VIN/delivery/upgrade cue; accessible list and null placeholders.

sections.name: Order details
sections.content: Six columns: model, order_id, vin, status, delivery, upgradable; all table interactions and exports.

actions.name: Refresh account orders
actions.behavior: POST refresh, header pending/aria-busy, localized label and mutation toast feedback.

actions.name: Empty board/table Refresh
actions.behavior: Same mutation from two persistent empty-panel recovery controls.

actions.name: Retry read
actions.behavior: refetch GET; preserve per-section error recovery and shared source notice recovery.

actions.name: Text filter
actions.behavior: Trimmed case-insensitive model/order ID/VIN/raw status search.

actions.name: Column value filters
actions.behavior: Existing DataTable value filters seeded from all orders, not only text-filtered rows.

actions.name: Sort model/status/delivery
actions.behavior: Default model ascending, bucket-based status sorting, date epoch sorting; invalid/missing delivery sorts as zero, not a displayed measured zero.

actions.name: CSV/JSON export and column preferences
actions.behavior: Inherited loaded matching-result export, shared visible-column serialization and tableId-based persistence; no server-wide export or row selection is configured by OrdersTable.

dataBehavior: Retain every raw TeslaOrder field in the query/cache, including referral_code and per-order timestamps not currently displayed.
Preserve account-level GET/POST ownership, cancellation, staleTime, query key, mutation invalidation, toast feedback and rate-limit semantics.
Keep classification precedence: cancelled/rejected, ready/transport/transit, delivered, pending/order/book/prep/production/build, other. Do not recase stored statuses.
Keep all aggregates and next-delivery selection; current clock-dependent calculation updates on order-array recomputation, not a separate ticking interval.
Keep empty successful arrays distinct from absent/malformed data; preserve summary null input guard and unknown placeholders.
Retain locale/timezone formatting, snapshot-not-range provenance, underlying source timestamps and existing display preferences.
Keep live data visible after background refresh failure, independent panel states, retry actions and rendered section shells.
No units are inferred or transformed on wire/cache; inspected order fields are identities, dates, statuses, counts and booleans.
